verdict.rationale: No option clearly dominates: A maximizes meeting proximity, B balances a short walk with included breakfast and room amenities, C offers the strongest kitchen setup, and D minimizes the all-in hotel cost while retaining walkability and basic amenities. Mild weather makes B and D viable, but it does not establish how to value walking distance, breakfast, kitchen capacity, or price differences.
